title: Supervolcanic Eruption of Toba
description: Around 74,000 years ago, a massive supervolcanic eruption occurred at the site of Lake Toba, registering as a VEI 8 event. This is the largest known explosive eruption on Earth in the last 25 million years, creating a global volcanic winter and a genetic bottleneck in human evolution.

title: King Sisingamangaraja XII
description: The last priest-king of the Batak people, Sisingamangaraja XII (1845–1907) led a decades-long heroic guerrilla resistance against Dutch colonial expansion in the Toba highlands. He was declared a National Hero of Indonesia in 1961.

title: Batak Ancestral Origins and Migration
description: The Batak people are Austronesian-speaking ethnic groups who settled the highlands surrounding Lake Toba thousands of years ago. Developing a unique highland culture, they organized into patrilineal clans (margas) and preserved deep spiritual, artistic, and legal traditions.
